text: Laravel 13 requires a minimum PHP version of **8.3** [1][2][1ey4f][3]. Specifically, Laravel 13 supports PHP versions ranging from **8.3 to 8.5** [1][2][1ey4f]. This means that older PHP versions, such as PHP 8.2, are no longer supported by Laravel 13 [3].
